description: The baseline applies to what the program's `lib` actually loaded, not to whatever a declaration happens to be named. With no `dom` in `lib`, an `EventTarget` the project declares itself gets no DOM color and floors, though the DOM baseline colors that very key clean.

diagnostics.message: Call to `target.addEventListener` escapes this `@nothrow` function: it is declared without a body — an ambient declaration, a `.d.ts`, or a value known only by its function type — and no mark, manifest, overlay, override or baseline entry colors it, so it is assumed to throw. Your outs, in precedence order: bridge this call with `try`/`catch`; assert the color in `nothrow.overrides.json`; install or write an `@no-throw/*` overlay; or, if you own the package, ship a manifest with `nothrow emit`.
